rows.title: Quarantine, Kill and reenablement do not preserve cause-proportional scope or non-resurrection
originalFrozenReproduction: Regression quarantine matches digest equality rather than overlapping Variants, lacks object-scope propagation and does not invalidate unexecuted recommendations/candidates/approvals/commands.
Authority-version quarantine records a reference but no gate consumes it.
Kill activation is not tied to actor role/max scope or a mandatory review owner; manual packets are not revoked by containment.
reenable() clears containment without permanently invalidating old decision assets, so a surviving pending command can become eligible again.
rows.originalFrozenRisk: Known bad authority can keep serving other consumers, a stale command can transmit after restart, and a user can stop/restart a wider scope than authorized.
rows.rootCauseFromReviewedCentral: Containment depended on digest equality or untrusted booleans and could restore old authority after a weak reenablement.
rows.implementedBehaviorFromCentral: Human and canonical regression stops synchronously invalidate approval assets and deny new side effects while preserving status/readback and uncertain reservation state. New dedicated authority-version stop requires exact Org-wide Owner/Ops policy scope plus Org Ops reviewer and actual consumed version. Object association follows Gate allowlists, frozen command candidate, and Manual authority references so a Store neighbor using another Profile/Bundle is not stopped. Org recovery requires live Org attestations, distinct Ops/Owner and no ACTIVE consumer still referencing the invalid version; version bans and historical invalidations survive review closure.
rows.currentIndividualEngineeringReason: Cause-proportional object/set/capability/version stops invalidate exact consumers and preserve readback-only unknown work. Actual Org-wide stop and multi-consumer independent reenablement cannot revive older approvals.
requiredReworkExact: Implement object + intersecting affected-set quarantine, authority-version consumer invalidation and exact capability kill.
Persist append-only invalidation epochs on every unexecuted asset and require fresh recomputation after reenablement.
Enforce actor-specific maximum stop scope, review owner, multi-party cause-specific reenablement, manual packet revocation/uncertain verification and transmission-boundary fencing.
requiredVerificationExact: Race tests for pending/leased/just-before-send commands.
Authority-version and overlapping-set propagation tests.
Old-asset non-resurrection and actor-scope adversarial tests.
